notes.title: Latest news
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! As you may have noticed, Ancient Guardian was banned today. And not only that, beloved Outdrive from our publisher was banned too. In fact whole publisher account was. Why that happened? Today Steam decided to wipe out whole game library from old, unrelavent, suspecious and abusing games. Is it bad? No. It is actually makes a lot of sense. Now question is how our publisher Denver got banned? Well, thats very interesting story. In the past Outdrive and Ancient Guardian was published from Siberian Digital(oldfags may remeber this) or Dagestan Technology, there is no difference. Lately we transfered our games to Denver, but story from old publisher not gone anywhere. You do the math.
Fortunately, we got us unbanned, thanks to Denverːminotaurː So Ancient Guardian and Outdrive is now available on Steam, eeyyyy. Our games was banned almost for the day. It was a pain in the ass day, not gonna lie.

Now the future. Ancient Guardian is almost 3 years in the Early Access. It's a long time. Honestly, we didnt even knew its going to be that long. But right now we focused on release on 23rd of December. And after release we are going to support our child.

notes.title: 0.5.8 update is out!
notes.notes:
Hello! So we released the first update from our new development cycle.
[list]
[*]New second level (alpha version) As we said, we are doing the second level from scratch. Only now, instead of doing it for a very long time, and then immediately releasing it ready, we decided to release it in pieces. In the first update: a new terrain, some basic mechanics and achievements. It is still far from what is planned. And to be honest, you can hardly call it playable, but it's better than nothing.
[*]Alternative (fast) ending. Now the game has the first of 3 possible endings. Although it is short, but getting it is not so easy)
[*]Difficulty levels in story mode. Now you can choose at what level of difficulty you want to go through the plot: easy - the labyrinth is smaller, the monsters and the Minotaur are weaker; normal - everything is as planned; hard - the labyrinth is bigger, and the monsters and the Minotaur are stronger. In easy mode, the player does not receive achievements, and in hard mode you will receive a special achievement. Also now leaderboards are divided into difficulties.
[*]Switchable view bobbing when running, walking, etc. Some players have asked to do this because they are getting nauseous.
[*]Fixed a ceiling bug. Optimized and improved sounds.
[/list]
In the next update, we will have an event prepared in anticipation of the Spring Festival (Chinese New Year), and will also completely redo the endless mode.

notes.title: How to recover old saves after the recent update
notes.notes:
In the recent update the executable file and data folder have been renamed so thats caused save files to lose. But thanks to [b]Nice Puppies[/b] we have a solution:

[quote]
I noticed that after I got the recent 0.5.1 update, all of my game settings were reset when I started up the game. I found out why. Before this update, the game's save files were saved at: "Steam\SteamApps\common\Ancient Guardian\lab_data\save". Now they are saved in a different location: "Steam\SteamApps\common\Ancient Guardian\AncientGuardian_Data\save". If you want to recover your old settings, you can simply just go into the "lab_data\save" folder and cut the two files that are in there (profile.dat and settings.dat), and paste those two files into the new location which is mentioned above. Then you can delete the "lab_data" folder because it's not needed anymore
[/quote]

Cheers!

notes.title: Treasure hunters
notes.notes:
Many of you during the game could stumble on the bodies of three people with different objects. But who are they? How did they end up there? And how did they perish? It does not reveal itself in the game. Today we decided to open for you this blind spot.

PROLOGUE

Drake, Anthony and Ashley are treasure hunters around the world, originally from the United States. They are engaged in this business not so long ago, that it would not be possible to call them professionals, but quite successfully. On the wave of their success, they decided to visit the most dangerous place among the treasure hunters - the Minotaur Labyrinth. They managed find information about it only in the very depths of the Internet. According to known data, the entrance to the labyrinth can not be found by your own, unless it calls for you.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/0373ce6b1697ae5b43825272e514bdac049f238f.png[/img]
[i]Crete, Greece[/i]

GREECE

Once in Greece, they went to the island of Crete in the city of Heraklion. It is there, according to the data, the alleged location of the labyrinth. 4 days they could not find the entrance, but one early morning they managed to find it where they believed they had been checked several times. At some point they already wanted to abandon their venture, but something unknown forced them to come inside. Thirst for profit or fame?

Entering the labyrinth, they decided to split up. Each of them had a flashlight, chalk and radio. Among other things, Drake had a first aid kit, and Anthony had a PM pistol, which he inherited from his father.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/507d7d5761ec315fc71270f8603ebcad4a9aa2fc.png[/img]
[i]Entrance to the labyrinth[/i]

ASHLEY

After a small search, Ashley managed to find the mysterious key, but she was not very careful and accidentally awakened the skeleton. She was very frightened and tried to escape from him. When she already thought that the skeleton was behind her, she was at a dead end, where in the last moments, the skeleton managed to sink the sword into her eye.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/482bfa83fd0042f92425efad1980913934b16bc6.png[/img]

ANTHONY

A woman's cry was heard all over the labyrinth. Anthony called Ashley on the radio, but she did not answer. They were long in love with each other and after this trip, Anthony planned to marry her, and on the found treasures arrange an incredible wedding. At one point, all of Anthony's dreams were destroyed. He had been trying to find her for a long time, but because of the panic he was only more lost. Going too deep, he ran into the Minotaur. The Minotaur saw Anthony lost hope and did not try to catch him. He just followed him, driving him crazy. Anthony could not resist, took the gun in his hand and shot himself in the head.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/724bbf959c922a493060bc16bf824229f1a812a9.png[/img]

DRAKE

The shot was heard all over the labyrinth. Drake already knew what had happened. He tried to go back, but the labyrinth seemed to only confuse him more. It seemed to him that he was walking in circles, about the same place. At one point he found a grate, which leads upstairs from the labyrinth. But no matter how much he tried to break it or shout, no one came to help. For almost twenty-four hours he sat in such despair, he no longer knew what to do. Drake slowly, with trembling hands, untied his shoelaces from his shoes, tied a noose on the grate and hung himself.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/35d74344bd3ae61c730c14aecc4f67be242b24f1.png[/img]

Good day, dear friends!

For us it was a pleasant bonus of its sale, which, in conjunction with the feedback and activity of users, motivated us to continue developing. Of course, there were negative moments, but they would not like to dwell on the eve of the New Year, let's just say that any experience, especially negative, is still experience, the main thing is that we learn from our mistakes and do not repeat them in the future.

For this year, Ancient Guardian has undergone many changes, ranging from minor graphics changes to significant changes in the gameplay and optimization. Also, the promised multiplayer and the second level began to appear. Unfortunately, we did not have time to do everything that was planned, for example, VR. But we fulfilled certain promises - Steam cards, more content, improved visual and technical components. And we will not dwell on this, the development continues and in fact it did not stop.

Also wanted to report on the replenishment of our ranks. We managed to find an excellent modeler - Sasha. For all the time he worked with him, there was no negative experience and we hope that this will continue) What does this mean? This means that we can accelerate the development, as well as improve the quality of models. One shot of two birds with one stone!

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/02c0462640e3b62eaff6a744e14a2294990cc254.png[/img]

[b]Improved player controller and updated animations[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/39ae09b92c0135a47435a80187a652dc1b1e375e.jpg[/img]
We reworked the player's script, made the controls more precise. Also, a large load was transferred to the animation, before the camera moved and shook through the code, now everything is controlled with the help of animations. By the way, the animations from the first person were completely redone, now they convey the dynamics of the character's movements. In addition, thanks to the new controller, we will be able to transfer new characters much faster!

[b]Improved AI[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/f2e4d89ab6efa505c076837f32e8686e63009dbe.jpg[/img]
A lot of work has been done with AI. We have completely updated and optimized the scripts of all AI characters, ranging from rats ending with the Minotaur. Also, now he is able to react to loud sounds and check their sources. A trap, which emits a loud sound, now will not immediately anger him.

[b]Improved effects[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/32d6cd045a86f9ea6c3a88502c9c4af5834c80cd.jpg[/img]
We reworked most of the effects, made them faster, in terms of performance, and more beautiful.

[b]Updated post-effects[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/134e68abf6425789b5c693d834250a6ac2a28f1d.jpg[/img]
Like effects, post-effects have undergone some changes. The effect of motion blur and glow became weaker to make the picture more clear.

[b]Optimization[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/f0f3bcb3b88cbc6c573887f3d1245c004026026c.jpg[/img]
Much attention has been paid to the optimization in this update. We fixed most of the weaknesses in the code, so we managed to raise the FPS by 10-20 units!

[b]Updated some graffiti[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/cb38e09da1d56f990b15ed93ca46d5f4d2aa277b.jpg[/img]
Some of the graffities were obsolete and did not match the game's lore, we reworked them. By the way, did you notice that the number of graffities and skeletons grows toward the end of the labyrinth?

[b]Added a hidden achievement[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/b88c1f8db8356af81edfd1c5325af5b57fcf35b3.jpg[/img]
Justice. We really liked the interaction with our players in finding solutions to achievements. As we promised - a new achievement. This time it is completely connected with the Minotaur, it requires compliance with 3 conditions. Good luck in getting it!

[b]New leaderboard in story mode[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/9af6998a5ec74e3db62a85e9079c4e359c93cbbd.jpg[/img]
We noticed a tendency in the passage of the story mode as quickly as possible, now all your passages will be recorded in a separate leaderboard! How did we not come up with this before?

[b]And much more...[/b]
You can see the full list of changes in our previous announcement.

[b]What's next? When is multiplayer?[/b]
Unfortunately, we will have to delay the multiplayer this time. At the moment it is ready for ~ 60%. In December, our project will be shown at the gameplanet exhibition, so we moved our focus to creating a second level of story mode. Because of this delay, and thanks to the updated player controller, we'll add new characters already in the first phase of the multiplayer!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/055fe42e9eb4f34fe21577ff4e1ceace358afe8b.jpg[/img]
[i]Not a big teaser of the second level for those who have read to the end[/i]

[/list]
Unfortunately, the work on the multiplayer is not progressing as fast as we would like, but the work does not stop. notes.title: Multiplayer. Important announcement!
notes.notes:
Good day! Today we have an important statement for you about Ancient Guardian. As you know, we from the very beginning of development promised to introduce multiplayer, and actually so it will be. However, we decided to change the policy of its appearance in the game.
Firstly, we planned to completely make the multiplayer, and release it immediately when ready, with all the possibilities that we conceived. Now we decided that the development of multiplayer will be divided into so-called phases. With every phase new features will be added in multiplayer until we reach the final version that we have planned.

What does this give us as developers?
[olist]
[*]It will be easier for us to fully implement everything, there will be control and also we will be able to make breaks between phases.
[*]We will be able to quickly eliminate bugs and improve the gameplay, because every phase will be available to players.
[/olist]

What will players get from this?
[olist]
[*]They will be able to try multiplayer before, possibly to help correct early problems.
[*]Prizes will be given in each phase, but which ones, we will tell later.
[/olist]
Actually this is all, we hope for your support and understanding, thank you!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/e3d3bc4c98cfdf730bea9eb01465e6e6a32bc00f.png[/img]
Hello, friends! We are pleased to announce that work on a major update is over. In this update, our main focus was on gameplay and new content. Thanks to your feedback game become better and we are very grateful to you! We look forward to further communication and, with the help of which you can tell us more about game, what you like and do not like, so we can know exactly in which direction we should move.

Update key features:
[list]
[*]A more friendly gameplay
[*]Many fixes
[*]New game mode
[*]Steam cards, smiles, backgrounds and badges
[*]New content
[/list]
[i]*For more details, see the corresponding news[/i]

What we going to do next? Next, we plan to produce about the same kind of update, but this time focus will be on the technical part of the game, in particular, controls settings and optimization. Also, we will continue to add new content, we are already working on this and we hope that you will not be disappointed!

Thanks!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P6NOVf95j7k

notes.title: Upcoming updates
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/583b70332b95d8406b9cbebc053fc099587c889d.png[/img]
Good day, friends! It's almost been a month as our game Ancient Guardian came out on Steam, it's time to make a small conclusion. For us it was an unforgettable experience on the Steam platform. There were also failures / mistakes and successes. We are grateful to all of the reviews, do not think that we dont listen you) We collected feedback during the month and speculated about our game in general, and now we know by what vector it will develop.
In the near future we will release an update that will change many things in our game. Currently we are working on it and do not know how soon we can release it, but we will try to do it as quickly as possible.
In this update, the changes affected in most of the gameplay, because we want to, every minute spent in the game was unforgettable. We also introduce a new game mode that will add a little competitive element in our game. Of course we do not forget about the promised multiplayer, we do not stand still in that direction and much has been implemented, but we need time.

Thank you for attention!
